set.body: Provider implementation for ScalaFIM eco-neuroatlas-surface. Preserve membership, parcel/topology digest identity and wire strings. Surface/core and surface IO must avoid volume/transform/render runtime dependencies. Add neutral IO custody for AtlasAsset/AtlasProvenanceFiles, split generic realization errors/helpers into core with typed volume error wrapper, move existing surface/routing implementations and tests without aliases, verify JVM/JS/IO and exported classpaths; then Root caller deletion and immutable publication acceptance.
set.title: A1: Own surface atlas realizations, GIFTI loading and mixed template routes
